hook.text: 3D food printers extrude chocolate, dough, cheese, and plant proteins into shapes no pastry chef could create by hand.

buildup.text: Restaurants use food printers for intricate garnishes and desserts.

discovery.text: Redefine Meat prints plant-based steaks that mimic the fiber structure of real beef. Texture, fat marbling, and all.

twist.text: Printing food is slow and expensive per portion.

climax.text: Personalized nutrition is the endgame: meals printed with exact calories and nutrients for each person's needs.

punchline.text: Your dinner, designed by algorithm and built by robot.
